:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

[[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] watches a thunderstorm outside a window. He thinks about the pain from his wounds and heron brands, and [[Lews Therin]] whispers, "Sometimes, pain is all that lets you know you're alive." [[Davram Bashere]] enters and tells Rand the [[Seanchan]] want him to meet with the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]].

==Notes==
* Since Tuon is with [[Mat]] she could not be part of setting up the meeting.
